generation.scope: On every finite Frobenius window, reduced or not, a distinct actual opposite coordinate requires at least five sextics through the doubled projection. If the eighty conditions are independent the flip is forced and regular extension has a finite unique-candidate test. A general six-plane of bilinear relations has no standard regular extension, since finiteness of a single edge propagates in every standard regular window.

open_mathematics: Determine the extension locus where the eighty double sextic conditions are dependent, and recover all regular windows and degenerations beyond the clean opposite-root locus.
